resources.name: Channel Divinity
resources.note: Cleric 2. A shared pool: Turn Undead, Turn Undead (Paladin) and Preserve Life all spend it. A cleric gets one use per level, so a paladin uses channel_divinity_paladin instead, which is half a level.

resources.name: Ki
resources.note: Monk 2. A shared pool spent by Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, Step of the Wind and Stunning Strike.

resources.name: Sorcery Points
resources.note: Sorcerer 2. Gained by casting spells, spent on Metamagic and Flexible Casting. Accumulates rather than refilling on a rest.

resources.name: Bardic Inspiration
resources.note: Recharges dice on a long rest. The number of dice is your Charisma modifier, minimum 1, which is why the maximum is an ability modifier rather than a number. The die size is a tier on the Bardic Inspiration feature, not a property of the resource: d6, d8 at 5th, d10 at 10th, d12 at 15th.

resources.name: Wild Shape Uses
resources.note: Druid 2. Limits Wild Shape itself, which is why Wild Shape does not also carry a limit.

resources.name: Lay on Hands Pools
resources.note: Paladin 1. A pool of hit points, not charges, so the amount a feature spends is chosen by the player and the target regains exactly that many. The pool is 5 times your paladin level, so 5 at 1st, 25 at 5th, 45 at 9th, 65 at 13th and 85 at 17th.

resources.name: Hit Dice
resources.note: One per character level. Spent by Short Rest recovery and regained on a long rest.

resources.name: Spell Slots
resources.note: Tracked per spell level on the character sheet. Created by Arcane Recovery and by Sorcery Point conversion.

resources.name: Superiority Dice
resources.note: Ranger 3. Recharges on a long rest.

resources.name: Luck Points
resources.note: Not granted by a class. The Lucky feat provides it, and a character without that feat has none, so the cost resolves to 0 available.

resources.name: Superiority Dice
resources.note: Battle Master's Combat Superiority. The maximum is your fighter level or twice your Charisma modifier, whichever is greater - a single formula cannot express that, so it is approximated by the level-based formula and stated here. Note this is distinct from the Ranger's Superiority Dice resource, which shares the name but not the formula.

resources.name: Channel Divinity (Paladin)
resources.note: Paladin 3. Half a use per level, rounded down. A separate resource from the cleric's because the formula differs, and one resource cannot carry two ceilings.
